_source: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/pricing fetched 2026-09-06; USD per million tokens; cache_write is the 5-minute rate. meter_weight is meter percent per list dollar relative to Sonnet 5; Fable's 1.0 is measured: the 2026-09-06 5-tick Fable probe cost $1.08 of list value per 1% against $0.98 for Sonnet on the same cache-write-heavy payload (ratio 0.91, within probe error). class_weight is meter percent per list dollar for each token class relative to cache_write, the class the Sonnet probe is made of: output 1.8 is measured (2026-09-06 output-heavy Fable probe, $0.589 list per 1% against $1.081 for the cache-write-heavy payload, 9 prompts over 5 ticks so about +-11%); input and cache_read are unmeasured and assumed 1.0; the same class weights are assumed for every model.
